name: AEON
recent: Aeon Co. (M) Bhd. 近期获得分析员关注，2026年第二季度净利同比增长15%，但上半年核心盈利预计因消费逆风下滑。公司持续进行AI客户画像扩展，并庆祝42周年。此外，EPF多次申报股权变动。
notable: 2026年第二季度净利同比增长15%，得益于成本控制改善。
AEON Credit 将价值2920万令吉的忠诚度计划资产转移至其持股51%的子公司。
公司扩展AI客户画像应用。
risks: 分析员预计2026年下半年核心盈利将因消费逆风下滑14%。
EPF近期多次申报股权变动，需关注其持股变化。
earnings: 2026年第二季度（截至6月30日）营收为9.954亿令吉，同比微降0.4%，环比下降19.9%；净利为1420万令吉，同比增长15.4%，但环比大幅下降83.0%。净利率为1.4%，低于上一季度的6.7%。

recent_en: Aeon Co. (M) Bhd. has drawn analyst attention recently, with 2Q2026 net profit rising 15% year-on-year, though 1H core earnings are expected to decline on consumer headwinds. The company continues AI customer profiling expansion and celebrated its 42nd anniversary. EPF has also made multiple shareholding disclosures.
notable_en: 2Q2026 net profit rose 15% year-on-year on better cost controls.
AEON Credit is transferring RM29.2 million loyalty programme assets to its 51%-owned subsidiary.
The company expanded its AI customer profiling application.
risks_en: Analysts expect 2H2026 core earnings to drop 14% on consumer headwinds.
EPF has made multiple recent shareholding disclosures; its stake changes warrant monitoring.
earnings_en: For 2Q2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM995.4 million, down 0.4% year-on-year and 19.9% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM14.2 million, up 15.4% year-on-year but down 83.0% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 1.4%, lower than 6.7% in the previous quarter.
